p: congregation: You counsellors of Saul, who under pretence of consulting for the common wealth, conspire my death being an innocent.
your hands in the earth: You are not ashamed to execute that cruelty publicly, which you have imagined in your hearts.
are estranged from the womb: That is, enemies to the people of God even from their birth.
adder that stoppeth her ear: They pass in malice and subtilty the crafty serpent who could preserve himself by stopping his ears from the enchanter.
teeth: Take away all opportunity and means by which they hurt.
melt away as waters which run: Considering God's divine power, he shows that God in a moment can destroy their force of which they brag.
Before your pots can feel the: As flesh is taken raw out of the pot before the water boils: so he desires God to destroy their enterprises before they bring them to pass.
rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: With a pure affection.
blood of the wicked: Their punishment and slaughter will be so great.
Verily there is a reward for: Seeing God governs all by his providence, he must put a difference between the godly and the wicked.
